tasks.title: Create the public repository dav033/david-ui with a root commit and scaffold the npm-workspaces monorepo toolchain
tasks.objective: A public GitHub repository and local checkout hold an npm-workspaces monorepo whose package builds with tsc, whose Next 16 catalog renders an export of the workspace package, and whose toolchain, scripts, CI and compatibility validator every later task relies on.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional engineering estimate in minutes: 40 repository and remote creation + 130 workspace scaffold, tool configuration, CI and README + 50 compatibility validator with fixtures + 50 boot smoke, e2e spec and own checks = 270. History for kind implement returned status unknown with no comparable samples; no empirical calibration is claimed.

complexity.justification: Wiring npm workspaces so a Next 16 catalog consumes the tsc-compiled package, while lint, typecheck, Vitest and Playwright all work inside the read-only verifier sandbox, needs cross-tool reasoning; high because every later task inherits these choices.
evidence: command:npm view next version -> 16.4.3 (React 19.3.1, @base-ui/react 1.9.0 on the registry)

scope.justification: T1 declares about 26 expected paths across the root, packages/ui, apps/catalog, CI and scripts, a large transversal change rather than one feature.

duration.justification: T1 allocates 40 remote creation + 130 scaffold and configuration + 50 validator + 50 smoke and checks, totaling 270 minutes; history has no comparable implement samples, so this breakdown is provisional.

coupling.justification: Every later task runs the root scripts, workspace layout and test configuration this scaffold defines; the named coordination boundary is contract:toolchain.

tasks.title: License and compatibility spike: per-source redistribution verdicts, 22 enhancement and 7 capability routes on Base UI, notification engine and pinned versions
tasks.objective: A tracked matrix gives every source a primary-source license and a public-redistribution verdict, every Animate UI enhancement and capability a Base UI route, the kit one notification engine and every dependency an exact version, before any code is adopted.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional research estimate in minutes: 90 primary-source license reading for four sources and the Bencho blocks + 100 Animate UI Base UI variant and install probes for 22 enhancements and 7 capabilities + 20 notification-engine comparison + 30 version matrix and validation = 240. History for kind research returned status unknown; confidence is low because upstream availability of Base UI variants is unknown.

complexity.justification: Judging redistribution rights for a public package and finding a Base UI route for 29 Animate UI pieces needs reading licenses and probing installs with relevant uncertainty.

scope.justification: The spike writes one tracked matrix and one narrative report and changes no product code, a small change in size.

duration.justification: The spike budgets 90 license reading + 100 variant probes + 20 engine comparison + 30 matrix assembly, totaling 240 minutes; research history has no comparable samples.
evidence: command:python3 /home/david/dev/metodologia/skill/scripts/bitacora.py --project david-ui plan-json history --kind research -> status unknown, no comparable samples

risk.justification: A wrong redistribution verdict would let copied code with a forbidding license land in a repository that stays public, which cannot be undone once pushed.

coupling.justification: Pinned versions, the T3 dependency check, the T4 license register and every later component route read this matrix through contract:upstream-compat.

confidence.justification: Whether Animate UI ships Base UI variants for each piece and what each Bencho block license says are still unknown, so the estimate rests on preliminary evidence only.
evidence: assumption:Bencho block licenses are unknown until read
command:python3 /home/david/dev/metodologia/skill/scripts/bitacora.py --project david-ui plan-json history --kind research -> status unknown, no comparable samples

tasks.title: Catalog manifest with one file per entry, license register and catalog:check with exact inventory counts
tasks.objective: The package carries one validated manifest of the 93 inventory entries and 22 linked enhancements, one file per entry, plus a license register consistent with the matrix, and catalog:check enforces counts, status, metadata and license rules.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional engineering estimate in minutes: 60 zod schema and loader + 70 seeding 93 entry files and 22 enhancement files from the inventory + 30 license register + 80 check rules with tests = 240. History for kind implement returned status unknown.

complexity.justification: Encoding every R5 field, the status semantics, clean-room provenance and exact per-category counts as fail-closed rules needs cross-checking the inventory and the SPEC.

scope.justification: The manifest, its loader export, the register and the check form a feature verifiable end to end through catalog:check.

duration.justification: The manifest budgets 60 schema and loader + 70 seeding + 30 register + 80 rule tests, totaling 240 minutes without comparable history.
evidence: command:python3 /home/david/dev/metodologia/skill/scripts/bitacora.py --project david-ui plan-json history --kind implement -> status unknown, no comparable samples

risk.justification: A miscounted or loosely validated manifest lets entries be double-counted or silently dropped, a functional regression for every family milestone.

coupling.justification: Every component, catalog and agent-index task reads or updates manifest entry files through contract:catalog-manifest.

confidence.justification: The inventory counts and naming rules are written down, but the loader export and per-entry layout are new for this monorepo, hence medium.

acceptance_criteria: The catalog check accepts the seeded manifest with exactly 42 shadcn (30 P1, 12 P2), 7 capability, 12 Bencho (6 new-capability, 6 variant) and 32 React Bits (9 text, 12 ui, 6 effects, 5 backgrounds) inventory entries plus 22 linked enhancements, counting catalog-driven and own additions separately.

Manifest tests reject a wrong count, a duplicate id, an enhancement without its base entry, an implemented or validated entry missing required metadata or demo, a clean-room entry without consulted URL, date and license note, a blocked or discarded entry without a reason, a copied file without its upstream license header, a register source that disagrees with the compatibility matrix, and a pending entry in final mode.
The built package exports the manifest loader at @dav033/david-ui/manifest and it returns the 93 inventory entries and 22 enhancements to a Node consumer.

tasks.title: Kit-only guard check:kit-only over apps/catalog
tasks.objective: check:kit-only fails when catalog source imports primitive or animation libraries directly, reaches into the package source or renders raw interactive elements, and passes on catalog code built from package components.
tasks.estimate_rationale: Provisional engineering estimate in minutes: 70 TypeScript AST scanner for imports, re-exports and JSX + 50 planted-violation and allowed fixtures + 30 clean-tree run and wiring = 150. History for kind implement returned status unknown.

complexity.justification: Detecting forbidden imports, re-exports through local modules and raw interactive JSX with the TypeScript AST needs investigation of edge forms, not only text matching.

scope.justification: One scanner script with its fixtures and test is a small change limited to the guard.

duration.justification: The guard budgets 70 AST scanner + 50 fixtures + 30 clean-tree run, totaling 150 minutes without comparable history.
evidence: command:python3 /home/david/dev/metodologia/skill/scripts/bitacora.py --project david-ui plan-json history --kind implement -> status unknown, no comparable samples

risk.justification: A guard with gaps lets the catalog bypass the package unnoticed, a functional regression of R4 rather than a security or data loss.

coupling.justification: Every catalog task must pass this guard, so contract:kit-only-guard needs coordination, and the forbidden list reads the package dependencies that T3 installs.

confidence.justification: A previous REQ-001 revision built a guard that missed motion and @animate-ui imports, a known failure mode, but the new monorepo layout is untested, hence medium.

acceptance_criteria: The kit-only check passes on the current apps/catalog source tree and skips generated output.

Guard fixtures reject direct imports of the package's runtime dependencies and of framer-motion, @radix-ui, radix-ui and @animate-ui, deep imports into packages/ui/src, a local module that re-exports a forbidden library, and raw button, input, select, textarea, dialog and button-styled anchor elements, while accepting kit component usage.
